case.pattern_description: Device-ring fraud: one device profile, behind an anonymous proxy and flagged as a New device on almost every use, made online purchases on 28 different cards within about a month, one to three purchases per card. It matches none of the five documented patterns because the link is the shared device across unrelated customers, not any one cardholder's behaviour; the bank's own history labels the same profile undocumented (CC-3035, CC-2985, CC-2971).

case.summary: The investigation found that a single device profile was used to make online purchases on the card C13487-K1 and 27 other cards within a ±15-day window, indicating coordinated fraud. Evidence of a shared anonymous proxy and a device marked as New on almost every use points to fraud. An analyst confirmed the pattern and the case was escalated to a fraud analyst for further action. The card was blocked, the pending transaction was declined, and the case remains open for monitoring of the connected cards. The total exposure is $439.61, which is below the $2,500 threshold for immediate loss mitigation.

sar.narrative: During November 2016, the card C13487-K1 belonging to customer C13487 was used for an online purchase of $74.96 on 2016-11-22. The same device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) was observed accessing 28 different cards, including C13487-K1, within a ±15-day window, always behind an anonymous proxy and flagged as New on almost every use. This shared device activity linked the card to a coordinated scheme across unrelated customers, which is an undocumented pattern as described in policy R9. The pattern suggests organized fraud using a common device to compromise multiple accounts. The total suspicious amount across the three transactions is $439.61. The investigation identified the following subjects and transactions: C13487, C13487-K1, C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, C06031-K2, C06650-K2, C06710-K1, C07472-K1, C08168-K1, C08972-K2, C09049-K1, C09195-K1, C09906-K1, C09975-K1, C10020-K1, C10193-K2, C10326-K1, C11082-K1, C11670-K2, C11702-K1, C12645-K1, C12796-K1, C13291-K1 and transactions 3460634, 3478561, 3489320.
